summary: Carlos Ruhl Airport (CZB) is a small regional airport serving Cruz Alta, a city in the central plateau region of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The facility primarily handles general aviation and limited commercial flights, serving the agricultural and business communities of this inland area. Its modest infrastructure reflects the airport's role as a convenient local gateway rather than a major international hub.
